questions.question: When the people were bitten by snakes, what did God tell Moses to make?
options: A new staff of almond wood
A bronze serpent on a pole
questions.answer: A bronze serpent on a pole

questions.question: What happened to those who looked at the bronze serpent?
The people again complained against God and Moses about the food and water.

Moses set the bronze serpent on a _____ so the people could look and live.
